synthesis.procedure: In a 500 mL Schlenk flask, 6.20 g Sm2O3 (35.6 mmol) was suspended in 250 mL dimethoxyethane. The flask was flushed with argon and connected to a bubbler. 70 mL thionyl chloride was added dropwise over 2 h, then 10 mL H2O was added carefully. The suspension was stirred vigorously over the weekend and the product was filtered under inert gas, washed with DME, and dried under vacuum (1×10^-3 mbar) overnight as a colorless powder. Colorless single crystals were obtained from the mother liquor in a refrigerator after about 2 days.
synthesis.time: SOCl2 addition over 2 h; stirred over the weekend; dried overnight
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered under inert gas, washed with DME, dried under vacuum (1×10^-3 mbar) overnight; colorless single crystals from the mother liquor in a refrigerator after ca. 2 days.

synthesis.procedure: In a 500 mL round-bottom flask under inert gas, 10 mL (71 mmol) freshly distilled diisopropylamine was dissolved in 100 mL freshly distilled toluene. The flask was flushed with carbon dioxide until CO2 uptake ceased. Then 3.09 g (7 mmol) SmCl3(DME)2 was added against an argon counterflow, causing renewed CO2 absorption that ceased after one day. The mixture was filtered under CO2 and washed with toluene, leaving diisopropylammonium chloride on the filter. The solvent was removed under vacuum and the residue dried for ca. 3 h. The product was recrystallized from absolute heptane, filtered under inert gas, and dried overnight on a vacuum pump (1×10^-3 mbar). Pale yellow rhombohedral single crystals were obtained from the mother liquor after about 3 days.
synthesis.time: CO2 uptake for 1 day; dried ca. 3 h then overnight; crystals after ca. 3 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 500 mL round-bottom flask under protective gas/CO2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered under CO2 and washed with toluene; solvent removed under vacuum and dried ca. 3 h; recrystallized from absolute heptane; pale yellow rhombohedral crystals from the mother liquor after ca. 3 days. Two heptane molecules per formula unit are present as lattice solvent.
